verdict.rationale: The evidence documents APIs for customers, cases, per-customer monitoring configuration, exports and transaction processing, but nothing shows programmatic creation or editing of transaction-monitoring rules (such as velocity rules) or blocklist management. Nor does it show human approval gates on rule or list changes. The risk-score equation and screening configurations are adjacent features with no documented API or approval workflow. ComplyAdvantage's own AI agents escalating cases to humans is a different capability from an external agent proposing rule changes.
